title: SLONKS
author: Blockhash
facts: color classifier: picks the best of 18 candidate colors for each pixel (argmax over learned embeddings)
203,680 learned int8 values (10,000×10 embeddings and 576×18×10 pixel heads)
data contracts (SSTORE2): 214,048 int8 bytes in 9 locked contracts
trained offchain on the CryptoPunks image set; 95.77% pixel accuracy
576 palette indexes: a 24×24 reconstruction of the source punk
description: Slonks redraws all 10,000 CryptoPunks, a set of 24×24 pixel portraits, with a small model on Ethereum. The model learned 10 numbers for each punk. For each pixel, it uses these numbers to score 18 candidate colors, and the best score wins. Nine data contracts store the weights, and nobody can change them. The model runs inside Ethereum. The pixels that the model gets wrong are the art.

call.note: renderSourcePixels(punkId) runs the model for the selected punk and returns 576 palette indexes, one for each pixel.

input.label: PUNK NUMBER
input.hint: Choose a CryptoPunk number from 0 to 9999.

preview.note: Each byte is an index into the 222-color CryptoPunks palette. The preview shows the indexes as gray levels, not the true colors.
